name: cavemio-stepper-input
title: Stepper input
description: A tactile incrementer: tap to step, hold to accelerate, bounds give an elastic bumper shake, and digits roll in place.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Uses NumberRoll internally so numbers roll in the exact direction of travel (increment rolls up, decrement rolls down).
- Hold-to-accelerate uses touch-safe pointer listeners and clears all timers on pointer cancel or unmount.
- Arrow keys, PageUp/PageDown, and Home/End support the full WAI-ARIA spinbutton specification.
- Direct text edit automatically clamps and rounds to the specified step precision to eliminate floating-point arithmetic errors.
- Reduced motion replaces the bumper shake and roll animations with instant updates.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: label
props.description: – · Accessible name for the stepper, announced to assistive technologies.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: – · Callback invoked when the value changes.

props.name: step
props.description: 1 · Amount to increment or decrement on single steps.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: – · Step multiplier for PageUp/PageDown and sustained acceleration (defaults to step * 10).

props.name: unit
props.description: – · Optional text suffix displayed beside the value (e.g. "seats", "px", "%").

props.name: variant
props.description: "pill" · Border radius style: pill (rounded-full) or field (rounded-lg).

props.name: size
props.description: "default" · Control height and typography size: sm (28px) or default (36px).

props.name: disabled
props.description: false · Disables all interactions and dims the control.

props.name: name
props.description: – · Name attribute for hidden input submitted with HTML forms.

features.title: Odometer roll direction
features.description: Increments roll upward and decrements roll downward through NumberRoll, maintaining continuous directional feedback.

features.title: Exponential hold acceleration
features.description: Holds start with a 300ms delay to prevent accidental runs, then step at 90ms, 55ms, and 30ms with automatic 5x/10x multipliers.

features.title: Elastic bumper feedback
features.description: Hitting the min or max bound produces a brief horizontal elastic shake rather than dead-ending without feedback.

features.title: Direct editing in place
features.description: Clicking the number reveals a full input without shifting a pixel; Enter or blur parses, clamps, and commits.

features.title: Floating-point precision
features.description: Handles fractional steps like 0.1 or 0.05 without standard JavaScript floating-point artifacts like 0.30000000000000004.

features.title: Accessible spinbutton
features.description: Supports ArrowUp/Down, PageUp/Down for large steps, and Home/End for boundary limits, with polite screen-reader announcements.

states.title: rest
states.description: thin line pill or field container in rest state. Decrement and increment buttons display quiet icons with disabled styling when at bounds.

states.title: tap
states.description: Single tap or click advances by one step. The digit rolls in the direction the value changed over 260ms.

states.title: accelerate
states.description: Holding down past 300ms activates rapid stepping, ramping up to 30ms tick intervals with large-step multipliers.

states.title: limit shake
states.description: Attempting to step past min or max triggers an elastic bumper shake (±3px over 280ms) and disables the button.

states.title: direct edit
states.description: Clicking the value swaps the odometer for an active text input; Escape cancels back to original value, Enter commits clamped number.
